entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-04
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • JIT: SSA-based TryGetRange fails on constant #130206
    11.0.0
  • [aw] CI Outer-Loop Failure Fixer failed #130200
  • [aw] CI Outer-Loop Failure Scanner failed #130199
  • Applying pattern matching makes code not compilable #130198
  • `InvariantGlobalization` should prefer EN when formatting OS exceptions #130191

PullRequests

Created

  • Optimize multicast stubs #130207
    area-VM-coreclr

    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Handle STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND in Windows directory enumeration #130196
    area-System.IO
  • Update Matrix4x4 paths to use the new xplat intrinsics #130192
    area-System.Numerics

Updated

  • [cDAC] Implement DacDbi API GetUserState #130208
    area-Diagnostics-cdac

  • Stackalloc localloc conditional2 #127980

    area-CodeGen-coreclr
